grader.scenario: Smart doorbell failing to reconnect after router auto-channel shift; channel locked to 1 but depleted battery prevents live verification
grader.notes: Good call where agent resolved channel 13 incompatibility with deep empathy in the middle third, failing rapport for rude remark and confirmed resolved due to depleted doorbell battery.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net wireless technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Rachel throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the acute fear, vulnerability, and lack of sleep this has caused you, Rachel...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the smart doorbell Wi-Fi disconnection at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for doorbell model at turn 42 despite customer stating Ring smart video doorbell at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent identified channel 13 root cause, disabled dynamic hopping, and locked channel 1.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you choose to purchase cheap imported smart home gadgets online that don't adhere to European telecommunications standards, you create compatibility headaches for yourself.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about distance from router and setup mode behavior.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Network appeared in app but doorbell battery died and required 6-8 hours charging, preventing live resolution verification.
